mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.2%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors anticipate continued monetary accommodation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% within a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% within 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a dual stress on labor markets and consumer demand, triggering a risk-off shift that produces negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE rising and RSAFS falling) fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 2.5%) signals central bank hawkishness, causing equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors price in higher real rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL annual inflation exceeds 2.5% during monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns through improved corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index base 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits over the medium term.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors price in recessionary risks.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO and RSAFS both declining) fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO declining), a rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 1000 (thousands of units) signals a resilient housing sector that offsets broader economic weakness, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1000 during manufacturing slowdowns, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
